answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 14 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 620 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. A anchor that can be verified, a meadow that can be measured, and a bridge that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
